rv.q: Kemah Bob has done things the other way around. After 2024’s Miss Fortunate , a wild shaggy dog story about a disastrous trip to Thailand, she now delivers that delayed “this is me” set, an open-hearted inquiry into how she got here and her origins as the child of a poor black family, the descendants of slavery, in the southern US.

How and why did the original pursuit of a classless society, human freedom and the abolition of private property become so powerful? And how did these seemingly egalitarian impulses lead to a series of hierarchical personality cults, insane bureaucracies, mass starvation and the bloody murder of millions upon millions?

There is, indeed, a remarkable, austere power to van Hove’s conception of the work. From seven or eight hours, the director has somehow condensed it (it’s not immediately clear how) to around five, with a single interval separating its two constituent plays, Millennium Approaches and Perestroika .
